description: A property dealer tragically died from an accidental gunshot in East Delhi, leading to his cousin's arrest.  A disturbing video captured the victim loading and then accidentally firing the licensed pistol, which belonged to his cousin who was filming. Police are investigating the incident, including the possibility of creating social media reels, and have registered a case of culpable homicide.
title: Delhi property dealer dies in 'accidental' firing, cousin arrested after video goes viral
